content_sections.heading: About ABVTCDS Accountant
content_sections.text: The Atal Bihari Vajpayee Training Centre For Disability Sports, Gwalior operates under the aegis of the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India. Located opposite IIITM, Morena Link Road, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, the centre invites direct recruitment applications for the Accountant post governed by GOI orders, with selected candidates covered under the National Pension System (NPS) introduced w.e.f. 01.01.2004.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed format completed in all respects, accompanied by self-attested copies of testimonials/ certificates along with last five years ACRs/ APARs, integrity Certificate and Vigilance Clearance should reach through proper channel (wherever applicable) to the following address within 30 days from the date of publication of employment notification in Employment News: Deputy Director (Sports), Atal Bihari Vajpayee Training Centre For Disability Sports - Gwalior, Opposite IIITM, Morena Link Road, Gwalior - 474015 FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce/Economics/other related subject dealing with financial management from a recognized University. Having 2 years working experience in a public/reputed private organization/sector dealing with Accounts/cash/Budget/other related field in financial management. Working knowledge of computer Professional Degree/Diploma in cost accounts from Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICAI). Experience in dealing with matters relating to disabled sports persons. The maximum age limit is 40 years (For SC/ST – 45 years, for OBC – 43 years). Age relaxation of 10 years (15 years for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC candidates) in upper age limit shall be allowed to Person with Disabilities (PwD) suffering from (a) blindness or low vision, (b) hearing impairment and (c) locomotor disability or cerebral palsy subject to the condition that maximum age of the applicant on the crucial date shall not exceed 56 years.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Application fee of Rs. 500/- (non-refundable) drawn on any Nationalized Bank in favour of the CENTRE FOR DISABILITY SPORTS GWALIOR , payable at Gwalior should be submitted along with each application. No fee is prescribed for SC/ST/PH and Women candidates.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The position will be filled on merit by way of written examination as per the revised guidelines of Govt. of India. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for written test. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written examination.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post will be filled on direct recruitment basis and will be governed by GOI orders on direct recruitment. The candidates selected on DR will be covered under NPS introduced by GOI w.e.f.01.01.2004. Mere possessing essential qualifications/experience will not entail any candidate a right to be considered eligible for the post. The applications received without requisite documents or received after the last date will not be entertained. Advance copy of application received from an eligible candidate before last date of receipt of application may be considered provided duly forwarded application with required documents is received before the interview for selection is scheduled. The department / organization while forwarding application may please ensure that the officials who apply for the post shall not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later on in case of their selection. The Competent Authority, however, reserves the right to cancel or withdraw the vacancy without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) vacancy available for the Accountant post under the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Accountant position?
faq.answer: The Accountant post is placed in Pay Level 6 with a salary scale of Rs. 35400-112400.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce/Economics/other related subject dealing with financial management from a recognized University, having 2 years working experience in a public/reputed private organization/sector dealing with Accounts/cash/Budget/other related field in financial management, and working knowledge of computer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years (For SC/ST – 45 years, for OBC – 43 years) with age relaxations of 10 years (15 years for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC candidates) for PwD candidates subject to the condition that maximum age on the crucial date shall not exceed 56 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: An application fee of Rs. 500/- (non-refundable) drawn on any Nationalized Bank in favour of the CENTRE FOR DISABILITY SPORTS GWALIOR, payable at Gwalior should be submitted along with each application. No fee is prescribed for SC/ST/PH and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: The application in the prescribed format completed in all respects, accompanied by self-attested copies of testimonials/ certificates along with last five years ACRs/ APARs, integrity Certificate and Vigilance Clearance should reach through proper channel (wherever applicable) to the Deputy Director (Sports), Atal Bihari Vajpayee Training Centre For Disability Sports - Gwalior within 30 days from the date of publication of employment notification in Employment News.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection procedure for this post?
faq.answer: The position will be filled on merit by way of written examination as per the revised guidelines of Govt. of India. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for written test.
